package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for stmt_without_close: Prepared statements or similar DB handles without an observed Close() call.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func scenario398Positive(db *sql.DB, id int) (string, error) {
	stmt, err := db.Prepare("SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = ?")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	var name string
	err = stmt.QueryRow(id).Scan(&name)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return name, nil
}
